rules.title: Rules of
rules.subtitle: Understand how the scoring system, deadlines, and special knockout stage rules work.

scoring.title: Scoring Table
scoring.detail1Desc: You got both home and away goals exactly right.
scoring.detail2Desc: You got the winner (or draw) right and at least one team's goals, but not the exact score.
scoring.detail2Note1: Got Brazil's win + Serbia's 0 goals right. Only missed Brazil's goals.
scoring.detail2Note2: Got Brazil's win + Argentina's 1 goal right.
scoring.detail3Desc: You only got who won or that it was a draw, but missed both teams' goals.
scoring.detail3Note1: Got Brazil's win, but missed both teams' goal counts.
scoring.detail3Note2: Got the draw right, but missed both scores.
scoring.detail4Desc: You got the outcome wrong (winner/draw), but got one team's goals exactly right.
scoring.detail4Note: Missed the winner, but got Cameroon's 1 goal right.
scoring.detail5Desc: You missed the result and both teams' goals. No points awarded.
scoring.detail5Note: Missed the winner and both teams' goals.

penalty.title: Post-Regulation Bonus
penalty.desc: If the match ends level after 90 minutes and requires a decision (extra time or penalties), you earn +5 points for correctly picking which team advances. This bonus is independent of the regulation-time scoreline.
penalty.exampleNote: 10 pts (exact score at 90 min) + 5 pts (advancement bonus) = 15 pts

knockout.title: Knockout Stage
knockout.rule1Desc: In the knockout stage, score bets consider only the result at the end of 90 minutes (regulation time). Extra time and penalties do not count toward the score.
knockout.rule2Desc: If you predict a draw in a knockout game, you must also pick the team that advances (penalty shootout winner). This field is only available for knockout matches.
knockout.rule3Desc: If the match ends level after 90 minutes, you earn points for the predicted score/result as normal. Correctly picking the team that advances (via extra time or penalties) adds +5 bonus points.
knockout.rule4Desc: Knockout stage bets only become available after all group stage matches are concluded. Don't miss the deadline!

deadline.title: Betting Deadline
deadline.groupDeadlineDesc: You can place (or edit) your bet up to 5 minutes before each match starts. After that, the bet is locked for that specific game.
deadline.knockoutDeadlineDesc: The same deadline applies: knockout bets open once the previous stage ends, but lock 5 minutes before each game.
deadline.bonusDeadlineDesc: Champion, runner-up, and top scorer must be picked before the tournament starts. Once the first whistle blows, these bets are locked permanently.

bonus.title: Bonus Bets
bonus.championDesc: Pick the team that lifts the trophy and earn bonus points at the end of the tournament.
bonus.runnerUpDesc: Pick the finalist who loses the final and add more points to your total.
bonus.topScorerDesc: Pick the player who scores the most goals in the tournament and secure the extra points.

general.title: General Rules
general.rule1: Points are calculated automatically by the system once the administrator finalizes and confirms each match result.
general.rule2: Bets cannot be changed after a match starts. Plan your predictions in advance.
general.rule3: In case of a ranking tie, position is determined by a tiebreaker: the highest number of exact score predictions.
general.rule4: Banned or deactivated players will not appear in the ranking and will lose their accumulated points.
general.rule5: The rules may be updated at any time by the administration, with prior notice to participants.
